overall_reason: A dark shadcn and Tailwind v4 system runs the page: font sizes all on tokens, a 16px card radius on 60 elements, two text colours and one teal accent, with one reference to a missing spacing token.

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY, T-SCALE-FIT and T-DRIFT-PAIRS pass (font size on_token 1.0, radius on_token 0.86, colour declarations 93% var); T-THEME-PARITY and T-HARDCODE each find one gap (TOK-009, TOK-006).

findings.evidence: theme.base_semantic_colour_tokens is 1 while the .dark block holds 61 tokens, and theme.dark_only_names includes --background, --accent, --accent-foreground and --badge-outline: the role set exists only under .dark.
findings.before: Roles declared only for the dark class; the unset mode has none
findings.after: Declare the roles on :root (the shipped dark values) and keep .dark only if a light theme is added
findings.why: If the dark class is ever missing, every role falls back to nothing.

findings.evidence: tokens.undeclared_references.without_fallback includes --spacing-4 (2 uses), which no readable sheet declares; the Tailwind v4 layer names its spacing base --spacing.
findings.before: Two rules read a token that does not exist
findings.after: Use calc(var(--spacing) * 4) or the p-4 utility
findings.why: A missing token silently resolves to the initial value.

strengths: Font sizes are 100% on tokens (9 steps) and spacing is on the 8px base, the same at 375.
One card radius of 16px on 60 elements; card_kit shows one recipe for the feature cards.
Two text colours by role (#f8fafc headings, #94a3b8 body) and one teal accent with alpha steps.
not_investigated: Only one scheme ships; the dark theme is the rendered one.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade (desktop app download page); no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
